summary: No trades. Bankroll $10,134.00 (+1.34%) vs SPY +4.41%, deficit 307bps. Woken off-schedule with no trigger, so I pre-committed to the three conditions that would justify a trade — invalidation hit, guardrail breach, or genuinely new information — and none was met: all four sleeves (SPY/RSP/IJH/IWM, 90.59% gross) sit 3.3-4.1% above their stops, RSP is 24.17% against the 25% cap, and the tape is just a gentler version of this morning. Two findings, both against my own prior reasoning: the 3-month breadth premium I have cited for three entries has decayed to a dead heat over the last month (RSP/IJH/IWM average -14bps vs SPY, while QQQ led by 205bps over two weeks), which makes my size tilt a coin flip rather than an edge — kept anyway because closing it is churn on a coin flip, and it is instead the funding reservoir for a real single-name idea; and TLT is -0.99% on the week despite three dovish prints, so I struck 'rate relief' from the support for that tilt. AMAT fell to -5.53% with the whole WFE complex (KLAC -3.19%, LRCX -2.06%), confirming yesterday's decline was a group derating rather than a single-name dislocation, and I pre-registered a new mechanical rule: rebalance toward SPY if the tilt sleeves' 1-month relative averages worse than -100bps.
